source.title: Changes in the WCA Board of Directors (June 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

With the term of Board Members Ethan Pride and Kerrie Jarman coming to an end, an anonymous election took place on **June 1st, 2025.** The election was conducted according to the [WCA Motion: Election of Directors](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2025.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf).

<!-- break -->
As Ethan has completed his third consecutive term, he is not eligible for re-election. Ethan's term on the WCA Board of Directors will be concluded on **July 1st, 2025**. We thank him for his tremendous service as both a WCA Board member, WCA Chair, and WCA Executive Director.

The Board received the applications of:

* Abdullah Gulab
* Kerrie Jarman

We are happy to announce that the election was successful and that Kerrie was re-elected and Abdullah was newly elected member of the WCA Board of Directors.

These changes have become effective immediately.

The applications can be viewed [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1f-Zy43Z8nYtEEPE7r4ZBc2BKFlxDhPmo?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 董事会成员变动（2025 年 6 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

随着董事 Ethan Pride 和 Kerrie Jarman 的任期即将结束，WCA 于 **2025 年 6 月 1 日**举行了不记名选举。此次选举依据[《WCA 董事选举动议》](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2025.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf)进行。

Ethan 已连续任职三届，不能再参加连任选举。他在 WCA 董事会的任期将于 **2025 年 7 月 1 日**结束。感谢他担任 WCA 董事、主席和执行董事期间所作的杰出贡献。

董事会收到以下两人的申请：

* Abdullah Gulab
* Kerrie Jarman

我们很高兴地宣布，选举顺利完成，Kerrie 成功连任，Abdullah 新当选为 WCA 董事会成员。

上述变动已立即生效。

申请材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1f-Zy43Z8nYtEEPE7r4ZBc2BKFlxDhPmo?usp=sharing)查看。
